visibleFields.truth: visible in perfectKnowledge mode or when hidden truth is explicitly included
visibleFields.forecasts: forecast ensemble members with id, label, and frames
visibleFields.priorityTargets: temporal Gold Star / priority target frames visible to external solvers
visibleFields.depth: optional bathymetry grid from shallow 0 to deep 1
visibleFields.roi: ROI cells may be numeric or { value, probability, expectedValue }

planningData.scoringMode: mission ROI scoring mode: expectedValue | realizedStochastic
planningData.stochasticSeed: seed used for deterministic stochastic ROI outcomes
planningData.priorityTargets: normalized mission priority target display/capture config
planningData.navigationUncertainty: dead-reckoning uncertainty config and GPS correction/display hints used for cone-aware risk grading
planningData.vectorField: current generator metadata including preset, strength, variability, seed, stats, and synthetic/current notes
planningData.currentFieldConfig: serializable visible current/flow-field setup: static/dynamic mode, base preset, evolution behavior/speed, explicit timeMode, cycleDurationHours, frameInterpolation, dynamicComplexity, variation levels, additive layers, spatial influence, topologyComposite regional metadata/assigned behaviors when using Topology-Aware Composite, and stochastic forecast-confidence metadata when applicable
planningData.sampleFieldConfig: serializable visible sample-value setup: spatialPattern, temporalBehavior, stateModel (timeIndexed/stateEvolving/historyAware), objectiveModel, stochasticity, currentCoupling, depletion, hotspot/burst/moving/plume/channel/gradient metadata when configured
planningData.importedFlowField: optional visible anchor.flow-field payload when the challenge currents came from an import
planningData.currentFieldVisibility: declares whether visible current config/frames are included and whether hidden truth-current frames are withheld or included
planningData.planningMarkers: optional global current plan markers; non-executable notes for future windows
planningData.waypointSemantics: Executable waypoints may include kind navigation | surface | samplingTarget | terminalCarryThrough. Treat navigation as commanded dead-reckoned intent, surface as GPS/update/replan, samplingTarget as objective metadata unless converted, and terminalCarryThrough as truncate-at-mission-end.
planningData.riskFields: probabilisticROI, ensembleForecasts, mobileHazards, depth, staticHazards, and scoringMode
planningData.solverHints: human-readable risk-aware planning hints for baseline/external solvers

visibility.truthIncluded: false for ordinary stochastic solver packets
visibility.oracleMode: true only when explicitly exporting hidden truth for benchmarking
visibility.publicChallenge: whether packet follows fair player-facing visibility

algorithmSupport.graphSearch: A*/Dijkstra/time-expanded graph metadata and cost model notes
algorithmSupport.multiAgentPlanning: agent ids, shared reward, duplicate sampling, conflict notes
algorithmSupport.neuralPlanning: tensor, graph, and sequence feature notes

missionRules.endCondition: none | surface | communication | recovery | pickup | return plus target/bonus/penalty fields
missionRules.sampling: unique | diminishing | cooldown | persistent plus duplicate/depletion/cooldown multipliers

waypointSemantics: Expected plans should preserve waypoint kind. Missing kind defaults to navigation for backward compatibility.

deployment.agents: agentId, mode, zoneId, allowedCells, selectedStart. Solvers may choose selectedStart from allowedCells when null.

connectivity.deploymentConnected: whether at least one valid deployment cell reaches navigable water
connectivity.reachableNavigableRatio: fraction of navigable water reachable from deployment
connectivity.roiReachableRatio: fraction of high-value ROI targets reachable from deployment
connectivity.recoveryReachable: whether required recovery/communication target cells are reachable

stochasticConfig.enabled: boolean; true for forecast challenge packets

vectorField: Top-level vectorField mirrors level.meta.generationConfig.currentGenerator or vector preset metadata so external solvers can identify the current preset used to generate visible frames.
currentFieldConfig: Top-level currentFieldConfig mirrors level.meta.generationConfig.currentFieldConfig so external solvers can reproduce the visible current setup behind the exported temporal frames.
sampleFieldConfig: Top-level sampleFieldConfig mirrors level.meta.generationConfig.sampleFieldConfig so external solvers can explain or reproduce visible generated sample-value frames when the replay contract is complete. stateModel uses timeIndexed, stateEvolving, or historyAware terminology.
navigationUncertainty: Top-level navigationUncertainty mirrors mission.rules.navigationUncertainty and level.meta.generationConfig.navigationUncertainty. Solvers should account for cone overlap with land/hazards when enabled.
importedFlowField: Top-level importedFlowField mirrors level.meta.generationConfig.importedFlowField so external solvers can inspect source/fairness metadata and imported frame/config behavior.
priorityTargets: Top-level priorityTargets mirrors level.layers.priorityTargets after normalization: id, label, value, radius, captureMode, frames.
notes: Solver packets contain the current level, mission, visible planning fields, challenge mode, selected forecast member, ROI view mode, optional planning markers, and an expected anchor.plan shape. Forecast mode packets include forecast/ensemble data, probabilistic ROI, mobile hazards, priority targets, and depth for risk-aware baseline solvers. Truth is included only when explicitly requested for benchmarking. Planning markers are study notes only and should not be treated as executable waypoints unless a solver intentionally converts them.
